# Asian American Education Project

> > The Asian American Education Project provides comprehensive lesson plans and curriculum resources on Asian American and Pacific Islander history, focusing on immigration, civil rights, labor organizing, and cross-cultural solidarity.

The organization develops the Hidden Voices curriculum and educational materials covering critical topics from the Chinese Exclusion Act to contemporary activism. Resources are designed for K-12 educators and include primary sources, with alignment to standards from institutions like the New York City Department of Education.

## Key Topics

- Chinese Exclusion Act
- Cross-cultural solidarity
- Immigration policy and history
- Hidden Voices curriculum
- Ethnic studies movement
- Anti-Asian violence and discrimination
- Labor organizing and workers' rights
- Black-Asian solidarity
- Civil Rights Movement connections
- Model minority stereotype
- Third-World Liberation Front
- Filipino American activism
- South Asian American contributions
- Primary source analysis
- AAPI history education

## Immigration and Exclusion History

- [Chinese Exclusion Act and the Exclusion of Asians, Pacific Islanders & Chinese Women](https://asianamericanedu.org/chinese-exclusion-act-exclusion-of-asians.html): Lesson plan on Chinese Exclusion Act & Asian immigration restrictions
- [Immigration and Nationality Act of 1965 – Civil Rights Movement Era](https://asianamericanedu.org/immigration-and-nationality-act-of-1965.html): Lesson on 1965 Immigration Act ending quota system during Civil Rights era
- [Fighting for Belonging: Black Liberation and Immigrant Rights](https://asianamericanedu.org/fighting-for-belonging.html): Lesson on Black-Asian solidarity, immigration & model minority stereotype
- [Redefine American](https://asianamericanedu.org/redefine-american.html): K-5 lesson on early Asian immigrants redefining American identity 1850s-1920s

## Civil Rights and Social Justice Activism

- [Fighting For Education: Ethnic Studies and Third-World Liberation Front](https://asianamericanedu.org/fighting-education.html): Lesson on ethnic studies movement & Third-World Liberation Front activism
- [Dr. Mabel Ping-Hua Lee and Women's Suffrage](https://asianamericanedu.org/mabel-lee.html): Lesson on Dr. Mabel Lee's role in women's suffrage despite exclusion laws
- [South Asian Influence on Nonviolence Movement](https://asianamericanedu.org/south-asian-influence-nonviolence.html): Lesson on Gandhi & South Asian influence on Civil Rights nonviolent movement
- [From Tragedy to Activism: The Case of Joseph Ileto](https://asianamericanedu.org/joseph-ileto.html): Lesson on Joseph Ileto hate crime & Filipino American anti-hate activism

## Labor and Economic Justice

- [Fighting for Labor Rights: Cross-Cultural Organizing](https://asianamericanedu.org/fighting-labor-rights.html): Lesson on Asian American labor organizing & cross-cultural solidarity
- [Philip Vera Cruz: Justice for Farm Workers](https://asianamericanedu.org/philip-vera-cruz-justice-for-farmworkers.html): Lesson on Philip Vera Cruz & Filipino American farm workers movement
- [Human Trafficking: Enslaved Thai Garment Workers of El Monte](https://asianamericanedu.org/human-trafficking-sweatshop-slavery-el-monte-thai-garment-workers.html): Lesson on El Monte sweatshop & Thai garment workers trafficking case

## Violence and Discrimination

- [Chinese Massacre of 1871](https://asianamericanedu.org/chinese-massacre-of-1871-not-an-isolated-event.html): Lesson plan on 1871 Los Angeles Chinese Massacre & anti-Chinese violence

## Land Rights and Community

- [Fighting for Land Rights: Alien Land Laws and Native Hawaiian Rights](https://asianamericanedu.org/fighting-land-rights.html): Lesson on land rights, Alien Land Laws, Punjabi-Mexican & Native Hawaiian

## Language and Cultural Identity

- [English as an Asset: Bilingualism and Multilingual Education](https://asianamericanedu.org/english-asset.html): Lesson on bilingualism, Asian languages as assets, multilingual education
- [On the Road: Sikh American Truck Drivers](https://asianamericanedu.org/sikh-truckers.html): Lesson on Sikh American truckers & Punjabi contributions to US industry
